description: React component for a multi-tier donation form with tabs for selecting donation amounts, including logic for toggling between form views and tracking user interactions.

classes.name: SelectionTabs
classes.description: Component for selecting donation amount via tabs, with GA event tracking.

classes.name: DonationFormRow
classes.description: Component rendering the donation form with edit functionality.

methods.name: switchTab
methods.description: Handles switching the selected donation amount tab.

methods.name: handleAmountConfirmationClick
methods.description: Handles confirmation button click, triggers GA event, and shows donation form.

methods.name: selectAmountTabClick
methods.description: Handles clicking on a specific amount tab, triggers GA event, and sets donation amount.

methods.name: editAmountClick
methods.description: Handles clicking to edit the donation amount, triggers GA event.
